purpose: Prespecified final-only lexical paraphrases for frozen-Qwen hidden-layer/pooling polarity bakeoff; not contract authorization.

positive: Verifiable documentation corroborates the asserted event

positive: The available evidence leaves the eventual outcome indeterminate
